title: Edit PDF library: text blocks, add text/images, in-place edit with reflow
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit; A-17 and A-23 work on a real fixture and the saved file renders and extracts the new text
notes: Library half of the Edit PDF pair per ADR 0012. Serves acceptance items A-17 (click a paragraph, edit it, reflow, saved file shows and extracts the new text) and A-23 (Edit PDF tool: add, move, resize, replace and delete text and images) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Exposes text-block discovery, in-place text edit with reflow, and text/image insertion through the pdfxi-document session of ADR 0010, and proves each on real bytes that are saved, reopened and re-extracted. A serialised app shell task follows once this lands and owns the Edit tool in crates/pdfxi-app/src/shell/**; matrix rows stay `library` until that shell task verifies them.
